description: This Python source file defines debugging utilities for a proxy server, including memory profiling, garbage collection configuration, and tracing of asyncio tasks and OpenTelemetry spans. It also includes functions for detailed memory diagnostics and cache memory analysis.

methods.name: configure_gc_thresholds
methods.description: Configures Python garbage collection thresholds based on environment variable PYTHON_GC_THRESHOLD.

methods.name: get_active_tasks_stats
methods.description: Returns total active asyncio tasks and counts grouped by coroutine name.

methods.name: memory_usage
methods.description: Provides current memory snapshot, including top memory usage lines.

methods.name: memory_usage_in_mem_cache
methods.description: Returns sizes of in-memory caches used by the proxy server.

methods.name: memory_usage_in_mem_cache_items
methods.description: Returns cache item counts and in-memory cache dictionaries.

methods.name: get_memory_summary
methods.description: Provides a high-level summary of memory usage, cache states, and garbage collector status.

methods.name: configure_gc_thresholds_endpoint
methods.description: Sets garbage collection thresholds dynamically via API.

methods.name: get_otel_spans
methods.description: Retrieves and groups OpenTelemetry spans for tracing analysis.

methods.name: get_memory_details
methods.description: Provides detailed memory diagnostics including process info, GC stats, object types, and cache memory.

methods.name: init_verbose_loggers
methods.description: Initializes verbose logging levels based on worker configuration.
